RC-01.goal: Capacity 1: London Park Royal has ONE oil-change technician (Yuki). 10 different cars want 10:00 London time → exactly 1 x 201, 9 x 409. Two 201s = the exclusion constraint or the retry loop is broken.

RC-02.goal: Idempotency race: the SAME request with the SAME Idempotency-Key from 10 users at once (a client retrying in parallel) → 10 x 201 and ONE appointment id. A unique-key violation must be turned into 'return the existing one', not 409/500.

RC-03.goal: One car, many keys: the same vehicle booked 10 times at once with DIFFERENT keys at the hub, which has 6 free oil-change technicians and 8 bays → still exactly 1 x 201: the vehicle itself is a resource (DB-03).
